headline: More Than 20,000 Kilograms of Fish Die in Laguna de Bay Fish Kill
seoTitle: 20,000 Kg Fish Die in Laguna de Bay Fish Kill | FMB News
seoDescription: More than 20,000 kilograms of tilapia and bighead carp died in fish cages in Jala-jala, Rizal, with the cause still under investigation.
keywords: Laguna de Bay fish kill September 2026
deck: The incident affected more than 30 fish cages across over seven hectares; fishers suspected contamination, but the cause had not been established.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: More than 20,000 kilograms of tilapia and bighead carp died in a fish kill affecting more than 30 cages in Laguna de Bay in Jala-jala, Rizal, according to fisherfolk group Pamalakaya.
The affected cages covered more than seven hectares, with initial losses estimated at about ₱700,000.

sections.heading: Cause not yet established
paragraphs: Fishers reported unusual water discoloration and suspected that pollution may have contributed, but the Laguna Lake Development Authority had not established the cause of the latest incident.
The LLDA had previously warned that changes in weather, algal blooms and falling dissolved-oxygen levels can create fish-kill risks in the lake.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Fish kills can quickly erase the working capital of small fishers and cage operators while raising broader questions about lake water quality and pollution monitoring.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The key next step is an LLDA investigation identifying the cause and determining whether pollution, water chemistry, algal conditions or multiple factors were involved.
